resources.string: Pinch to resize preview; virtual display resolution is unchanged

Create a 720×1280 display at 320 DPI. Shizuku or root is needed to run apps reliably. Hiding the preview keeps the display running; closing the display interrupts tasks and may lose unsaved state. Recreate a closed display to start again.
Grant the overlay permission in Settings → Permissions to show the preview.
Close display #%1$d? This releases its resources and may interrupt agent tasks or lose unsaved app state. A new display can be created, but the previous session cannot be restored.
